snippet.title: Etch-a-Sketch: Knobby's Quest (PC) - Gameplay | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Etch A Sketch is a platform game based on the classic drawing toy. The player must help Knobby, one of the drawing knobs of the apparatus, to cross safely levels full of obstacles and perils. Using the mouse, the objective is to drawn lines to protect the character from harm, and to help him transverse gaps. Sometimes puzzles have to be solved before Knobby can proceed to the exit. Lines drawn from a fire source to bombs and dangerous creatures ignite them, opening paths and destroying the enemies. In some levels, Knobby has to rescue trapped creatures, or collect an item before the exit portal starts working.

▌PC Gameplays Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXEHhSievieFw3PRaPmrVQ4mTjr4BMRE0
